rows.en: to cut her lingering ties to Quattro,
she launches in her Qubeley herself.
In the Shangri-La colony in Side 1,
a boy who works as a junk dealer,

Handling even the new ZZ Gundam
Judau comes into his own as a Newtype.
his sister Leina, is kidnapped by Axis.

Ple had been raised by Axis
where Ple meets him in town.

But through Glemy Toto's mind control,

rows.en: and the Axis forces split into two camps.
Judau launches a plan to kidnap

rows.en: just before getting Mineva onto the escape craft,
and Judau is made to see that he

now head into a battle to the death...

rows.en: and gives chase, plunging deep into Axis.
and because Judau had lost Ple,
Worried for Judau on his own,

source subtitle has no space ('Core3'); kept verbatim
sentence continues in S02308 (next slice: 'show no sign of moving'); no trailing comma so the English joins

decisions: Narration in present tense where the JP uses the plain non-past (most rows); explanatory 'no de aru' backstory (S02297-S02301) in past/past perfect.
Where English word order forces it, content within a sentence is reordered across adjacent rows (S02260/61, S02268/69, S02294/95); sentence-ending row boundaries always match the JP.
Row-1 English subtitles converted to ASCII verbatim, including missing spaces (Side3, Core3).
Widths follow the 2.4x guide loosely; a few lines exceed it (S02228, S02237, S02247, S02270, S02291, S02293) and need measuring.
uncertain: S02228: zg16 lines 3-5 not found in neighbour slices, so the start of this sentence has no context; assumed it opens a new sentence after S02227.
S02263/S02304: kept 'Side3 Area' / 'Inside Core3' without a space, as in the source; could be 'Side 3' / 'Core 3'.
S02289: read the line as a fight to the death between former comrades (Rakan is in the Glemy Faction); chose 'battle to the death'.
S02276: 'isagiyoku' rendered 'with good grace'; could also be 'without a fuss' / 'graciously'.
S02242: 'following Amuro and Kamille' means following their line as Newtypes; slightly ambiguous in English but kept the row cut.
